verdict_text:
YES

The script builds the kept-index sets correctly: for the fused `query_key_value` weight and bias (axis 0, 768-row blocks, drop head 5) it keeps rows 0..3839 and 4608..6143 in order, and for `dense.weight` (axis 1, 256-wide blocks) it keeps columns 0..1279 and 1536..2047. It applies this to all 16 layers, leaves every other tensor and all names untouched, asserts the four required checks before writing, and saves a single `out/T2/model.safetensors` with 244 tensors. `index_select` preserves dtype, so float16 is retained.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
